(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A proofed frozen dough comprising: (a) a dough mixture of flour, water, and optionally additives, the dough mixture defining a dough matrix; (b) gas bubbles dispersed throughout the dough matrix; (c) a spent yeast component; and (d) a preserved yeast component, wherein the preserved yeast component comprises encapsulated yeast.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the proofed frozen dough comprises about 1 to about 8 wt.% of the spent yeast component.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the proofed frozen dough comprises about 0.1 to about 2 wt.% of the preserved yeast component.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the proofed frozen dough has a volume, and wherein the gas bubbles make up about 30 to about 90 wt.% of the volume of the frozen dough.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the gas bubbles comprise gas produced by the spent yeast component during proofing.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: A method for making a frozen dough product, the method comprising: (a) mixing dough ingredients to produce a dough composition, the dough ingredients comprising: i. water; ii. flour; iii. a first yeast; and iv. a second yeast; (b) proofing the dough, wherein during proofing the first yeast is spent and the second yeast is preserved, wherein the second yeast comprises encapsulated yeast; and (c) freezing the dough after proofing.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The method of claim 13, wherein at least 60 wt.% of the first yeast is spent during proofing.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The method of claim 13, wherein at least 50 wt.% of the second yeast is preserved during proofing.

(Currently Amended) Claim 20: The method of claim 13, wherein the mixing comprises mixing the water, flour, and first yeast for a first period of time, adding the second yeast and mixing the dough ingredients for a second period of time, wherein the first period of time is longer than the second period of time.

(Currently Amended) Claim 28: The method of claim 25, wherein the dough does not comprise chemical leaveners.
